presentation.summary: Shoko anime metadata with native Shoko search and Group-to-Series mapping.
presentation.description_markdown:
Uses Shoko Series/Search plus existing TMDB provider IDs to attach Shoko metadata to already matched Silo titles. Maps Shoko Groups to Silo shows, child Shoko Series to seasons, and AniDB-enriched episodes to Silo episodes. Adds filtered AniDB tags and Shoko/AniDB cross-references without requiring a second title match.

Community plugin by RickDB (https://github.com/RickDB/silo-plugin-metadata-shoko), built for Bloem on the Bloem plugin SDK.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install this plugin, then add **Shoko** to your anime library's metadata provider chain. Configure the Shoko Server address and API key in the plugin settings panel.

capabilities.description: Anime metadata from Shoko Server with AniDB + TMDB support.
Resolves shoko:// image paths to Shoko Server artwork URLs.

global_config_schema.description: Control which AniDB tags are imported as genres.
